correctness.rationale: Corollary 1 of Joós–Lángi gives the Steiner-normalized parallelotope sum. For each tree component on r vertices, deleting any row of its incidence matrix has determinant ±1 by recursively eliminating a leaf, so Cauchy–Binet gives Gram determinant r; disjoint components factor. The only dependent four-edge sets are squares. For three edges, the connected count is s+m(d−1)^2, and the wedge-plus-edge count is w(m−3d+2). With four edges, stars and brooms embed without vertex repetitions by triangle-freeness; the repeated-vertex length-four nonbacktracking walks are exactly four per square up to reversal, giving E_0−4q_4. Deleting a three-edge tree's four vertices leaves m−4d+3 edges plus one if the tree is a path closing a square, giving D_0+4q_4. Counting wedges avoiding the three vertices of a fixed wedge uses adjacent-pair overlap 2(d−1), endpoint overlap c_ab, and triple overlap 1; the sum of c_ab−1 is 4q_4, giving C_0+2q_4. The outside degrees after removing the wedge are d−r_x; the sums of r_x and binom(r_x,2) are 3d−4 and c_ab−1, so the wedge with two disjoint edges contributes B_0−4q_4. Subtract the five types and the dependent sets from all quadruples to get the remaining count A_0+q_4. The weighted coefficient is −α, strictly negative by the displayed rational square-root bounds. An independent exact Gram-determinant tally verified the same V1–V3 and the difference −7α between the two cubic circulants, whose square counts are independently 7 and 0.
residual_risks: The circulant test is finite corroboration; the census argument establishes the general claim. Recovery is at fixed n,d with unscaled incidence roots; it is not a graph-isomorphism invariant that separates all such graphs.

value.rationale: Canonical graphical zonotopes and the fourth Steiner intrinsic volume are both standard objects. It is meaningful to identify which combinatorial information first becomes distinguishable at fixed n,d: V1–V3 conceal square counts whereas V4 detects them with exact sign and scale. The two cubic 14-vertex graphs show the distinction genuinely occurs without changing degree, order, or triangle count. An explicit invariant is useful both to compute the geometric quantity without enumerating edge sets and to read a graph statistic from the geometry.
residual_risks: Restricted to this regular triangle-free class and normalization; neither universal four-cycle recovery nor a complete graph invariant is claimed.
